n4bc353059e.headline: Pacheco criticizes the way senators approved the border development law
n4bc353059e.summary: The Dominican Republic's Chamber of Deputies president criticized the Senate's approval of Law 28-01, which extends benefits to companies in border areas.
n4bc353059e.why: Legislation extending benefits to companies in border regions can affect investment, trade, and economic development in the Dominican Republic.

n057d4e74ab.headline: UAE utility company Utico wants a Dubai Financial Market listing
n057d4e74ab.summary: UAE utility company Utico aims to list on the Dubai Financial Market, planning to offload 20-30% of shares this year with a valuation of Dh3 billion.
n057d4e74ab.why: Utico's planned IPO reflects growing capital market activity in the UAE's utility sector, attracting investor interest in regional infrastructure companies.

n565e26f075.headline: It's become less expensive to buy gold in India, adding to UAE jewellers' problems
n565e26f075.summary: India's government reduced import duties on gold, resulting in lower showroom prices and challenges for UAE-based jewelers.
n565e26f075.why: India is the world's largest gold consumer; import duty changes affect global gold trade and regional jewelers' competitiveness.
